in_marathi.name: Medhavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intellect, Knowledge, Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Medhavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Medhavi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘medha’, meaning ‘intelligence’ or ‘wisdom’. It is believed to be a sacred name that bestows the blessings of knowledge and wisdom upon the bearer. In Hindu mythology, Medhavi is the name of a sage who was known for his immense wisdom and knowledge.
